Package com.sca4d.app.server.controllers

Class NotificationSettingsController

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.app.server.controllers.NotificationSettingsController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/me/notification-settings") public final class NotificationSettingsController extends Object
管理当前 Account 的领域化通知设置，不暴露通用 Settings key。
